note: Emotion's `<Global styles>` takes a `css()` class holding rules under selectors, an array of rule objects and classes (`false`, `null` and `undefined` skipped) and a function of the theme whose `theme.a.b` reads become `var(--a-b)`; Emotion's `target` and styled-components' `componentId` become a stable class on the element that extending components render too; a `label:` declaration in CSS text is dropped instead of written as invalid CSS; and `isStyledComponent()` of a styled component the build knows is `true`. New build errors: a `target` or `componentId` that is not one class name written as a string; `defaultProps` assigned to a styled component, which compiles to a function component whose `defaultProps` React 19 ignores; a `<Global>` class with declarations of its own or rules no plain selector names, a spread in a `<Global>` array, and a `<Global>` theme function reading the theme other than as `theme.a.b`
